people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
translations.bsb: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wasteland and Jerusalem a desolation.
translations.kjv: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
translations.asv: Thy holy cities are become a wilderness, Zion is become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
